note: The resource and latency targets of #4 (G7). Every ceiling here is deliberately null: no number is inferred from the earlier CLI peaks. The workload (scripts/measure-linux.sh) fills summary.json on the next CI Linux leg; proposed ceilings are then recorded here — as numbers, only once the user confirms them — and a non-null ceiling makes proc_tree.py check fail the run when the summary is above it. Pending numbers keep the check reporting 'pending' and passing. hidden-idle (#189) is Pane hidden with its default extensions; wakeups.per_second is the whole tree's thread wake-ups a second, whose per-thread counts summary.json lists beside it.
